title: Identity-Aware Recurrent Text Classifier
summary: Comments are lowercased, regex-tokenized, and encoded to head-truncated sequences of 220 tokens using a vocabulary of the 120,000 most frequent training tokens; padding and unknown IDs are reserved. Embeddings are initialized by skip-gram word2vec pretraining on training text, with negative sampling and frequent-word subsampling. A spatial embedding dropout layer feeds a bidirectional LSTM followed by a bidirectional GRU. Max and masked mean pools from both recurrent outputs are concatenated, passed through a residual ReLU/dropout dense block, and mapped to toxicity plus identity logits. Training uses weighted binary cross-entropy for toxicity and unweighted auxiliary binary cross-entropy for identity labels. Weights emphasize identity-bearing examples and toxicity/identity subgroup combinations, then are mean-normalized. Length-bucketed shuffled batches reduce padding. AdamW uses epochwise multiplicative learning-rate decay, mixed precision, gradient scaling, and norm clipping. Inference applies sigmoid to the toxicity logit and averages validation predictions from the final two epochs.
